title: Kosie releases a new track "Fascination" feat. Harry Mack & Whitney Myer
htmlContent:
Kosie releases a new track called "Fascination" featuring Harry Mack & Whitney Myer. "Fascination" is that special kind of music that is everything that makes people fall in love with a sound. The music sounds good but the feeling you have while listening to it is even better. The timeless feel of it resonates in every way, and will for sure be a record that you will keep coming back to for a lifetime.

The music is engaging from the start with a high energy sound in the production that they flex over for every second. The flows are strong enough to shine in the music, with impressive lyrics that pack a punch in every line to bring a thrilling display of music that you won’t be able to get enough of.
